# KraftCoder

> Enterprise AI consulting and strategy firm helping organizations turn AI into measurable business outcomes.

## About

KraftCoder is a premium AI strategy and technical execution firm. We help leadership teams move beyond the hype and focus on the 2-3 use cases that will actually move the needle in their P&L. Our delivery model is security-first, KPI-led, and engineering-excellent.

- Website: https://kraft-coder.vercel.app
- Email: hello@kraftcoder.com
- Location: Tashkent, Uzbekistan

## Services

- AI Consulting: Executive workshops, opportunity maps, and ROI models
- AI Strategy: Practical adoption plans aligned with leadership and operations
- AI Agent Development: Autonomous agents with human-in-the-loop controls
- AI Automation: Workflow automation across support, operations, sales, and finance
- Enterprise AI Solutions: Secure, governed AI programs for departments at scale
- RAG Systems: Knowledge retrieval grounded in your documents and policies
- Chatbot Development: Customer and employee assistants with guardrails
- Custom Software Development: Full-stack engineering for AI products
- SaaS Development: AI-enabled products for monetization and retention
- Cloud & DevOps: Deployment pipelines, observability, and infrastructure
